custom_commands: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -f /etc/snapper/configs/root ]; then BTRFS_SRC="$(findmnt -no SOURCE /.snapshots)"; BTRFS_DEV="${BTRFS_SRC%%\[*}"; umount /.snapshots; rmdir /.snapshots; snapper --no-dbus -c root create-config /; btrfs subvolume delete /.snapshots; mkdir -p /.snapshots; mount -o "subvol=@snapshots,compress=zstd:1,noatime,discard=async" "$BTRFS_DEV" /.snapshots; chmod 750 /.snapshots; chown :wheel /.snapshots; fi
set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -f /etc/snapper/configs/home ]; then snapper --no-dbus -c home create-config /home; chown :wheel /home/.snapshots; fi

set -euo pipefail; if [ -f /etc/default/grub-btrfs/config ]; then sed -i 's|^#\?GRUB_BTRFS_GRUB_DIRNAME=.*|GRUB_BTRFS_GRUB_DIRNAME="/efi/grub"|' /etc/default/grub-btrfs/config; fi; mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/grub-btrfsd.service.d; printf '[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/grub-btrfsd --syslog /.snapshots
' > /etc/systemd/system/grub-btrfsd.service.d/override.conf

python3 -c 'import re; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("/etc/mkinitcpio.conf"); t=p.read_text(); repl=lambda m: "HOOKS=("+" ".join(m.group(1).split()+(["grub-btrfs-overlayfs"] if "grub-btrfs-overlayfs" not in m.group(1).split() else []))+")"; nt,n=re.subn(r"^HOOKS=\(([^)]*)\)",repl,t,count=1,flags=re.MULTILINE); assert n==1; p.write_text(nt)' && mkinitcpio -P

set -euo pipefail; if [ -f /usr/share/grub/themes/breeze/theme.txt ]; then sed -i 's|^#\?GRUB_THEME=.*|GRUB_THEME="/usr/share/grub/themes/breeze/theme.txt"|' /etc/default/grub; fi; sed -i 's|^#\?GRUB_TIMEOUT=.*|GRUB_TIMEOUT="5"|' /etc/default/grub; grub-mkconfig -o /efi/grub/grub.cfg; systemctl enable snapper-timeline.timer snapper-cleanup.timer grub-btrfsd.service
